convertibility_reason: EA depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trading operations (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory). These functions encapsulate position management, money management, and order execution logic that must be manually reimplemented.

derived_values.name: count - net directional candle count over CandleTrendTotal bars
min_rates_total - minimum bars needed before signaling

other_exits: Oppposite signal closes existing position: sell signal closes long (BUY_Close), buy signal closes short (SELL_Close), gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MMMode=LOT, uses fixed lot sizing; when MMMode=FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE, uses deposit fraction of MM=0.1. Implementation is inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Core signal logic: counts consecutive bullish/bearish candles over CandleTrendTotal bars starting at SignalBar offset. If all CandleTrendTotal candles are bullish (iOpen<iClose for each), count equals CandleTrendTotal -> buy signal. If all are bearish (iOpen>iClose for each), count equals -CandleTrendTotal -> sell signal. Signal bar index (SignalBar=1) means it reads the previous completed bars, not the current forming bar. When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated on every tick. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are set to last bar date + one timeframe period, used by BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen for trade timing. Recount flag triggers recalculation if CopyOpen/CopyClose fails. All position opening/closing logic is encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions.
python_conversion_notes: The candle trend logic is trivial to implement in Python (count consecutive directional candles). The main conversion effort is reimplementing the TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose (with 4 margin modes), CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory. The MarginMode enum (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) determines position sizing and must be faithfully ported. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 points likely need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10 for forex pairs) - verify in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. The Deviation_=10 is slippage tolerance in points.
